lessons.trigger_precondition: Outbound scatter legs present within 7 days but zero consolidation legs
lessons.observed_failure: Predicted request_info instead of escalate_str due to narrow 7-day window
lessons.actionable_rule: Expand time_window_days to 14-30 days before concluding no consolidation exists.
lessons.reviewer_rationale: APPROVED via dev-split review: generalizable bounded parameter heuristic within PolicyConfig.

lessons.trigger_precondition: Consolidated inflow is 5-12% lower than distributed outflow

lessons.actionable_rule: Widen amount_tolerance to 0.15 and compute exact Decimal retained fee percentage.
lessons.reviewer_rationale: APPROVED via dev-split review: generalizable bounded parameter heuristic within PolicyConfig.
